message.text: Webhook delivery workers consume from an in-process Go channel, `asyncPostQueue`, with four goroutine workers. They do not use NATS or RabbitMQ. No queue is declared in the repository.
The webhook delivery workers consume from an in-process buffered channel. NATS and RabbitMQ are not used.

r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook workers consume an in-process Go channel, `asyncPostQueue` (buffer 128), started by `init` with 4 goroutines in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`; `PostAsync` enqueues, `Post` delivers.
